# Chapter 2: The Visitor

On the fortieth day of the storm a surveyor arrived by boat, soaked and apologetic.

"I was told the light was out," he said.

"It never goes out," she answered. "It only seems to when you are looking from the wrong side."

## The Numbers

He had brought figures of his own, and they did not agree with hers.

| Measure | Her ledger | His survey |
|---------|-----------:|-----------:|
| Steps   |         91 |         90 |
| Lamps   |          1 |          1 |
| Boats   |          0 |          1 |

They checked the steps together. There were ninety-one, and he conceded the point with grace.
